# ChatBot® - The Best AI Chatbot Software for Your Website | ChatBot.com

> ChatBot® uses AI-generated responses to instantly help your customers. Get 24/7 support and ultra-high satisfaction rates. Test an AI chatbot for free.

ChatBot® is a digital tool designed to simulate human conversation, often through text-based interactions. It can be powered by AI and handle user queries, automate responses, and assist in tasks like customer support or sales. The AI chat bot uses technologies like natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and generative AI to understand user inputs and provide relevant, human-like responses.
